newsitem.title: USA: IPL sets Dec. pipeline capacity rationing.
newsitem.headline: IPL sets Dec. pipeline capacity rationing.

text.p: IPL Energy Inc's Interprovincial Pipe Line said on Thursday it set apportionment for December on its Line 3 pipeline to Superior, Wisconsin from Edmonton, Alberta, at 15 percent.
Apportionment is the amount of oil expected to move on the line subtracted from shipper nominations.
Line 3 carries mostly heavy and sour crudes.
IPL said December apportionment for Lines 2 and 13, which carry mostly light and medium crudes, was set at nine percent for December.
No apportionment was set on Line 1, which carries natural gas liquids and petroleum products.
Interprovinical Pipe Line is based in Edmonton, Alberta.
